packages.title: NightLight
packages.description: webOS homebrew app for LG TVs that turns Eye Comfort Mode (blue light filter) on at sunset and off at sunrise, or at times you set.
packages.shortDescription:
webOS homebrew app for LG TVs that turns Eye Comfort Mode (blue light filter) on at sunset and off at sunrise, or at times you set.

Install/Update Notes
Open the app once after installing or updating to start the scheduler.
